description: This file defines a trait 'StreamDecoratorTrait' used to decorate and extend the functionality of a StreamInterface object in PHP. It includes methods for property access, string conversion, stream control, and metadata handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the decorator with a given StreamInterface object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to dynamically create or return the 'stream' property.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream to a string, reading contents if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying stream object.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches and returns the underlying stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Abstract method meant to create a stream if needed.
